description:
You are a Data Officer for the Sierra Leone National Malaria Control Programme. The Programme Director needs a ranked chart of the highest burden districts for the 2023 Annual Report. 

Using the DHIS2 Data Visualizer app (login: admin / district):
1. Create a Bar Chart (or Column Chart) showing 'Malaria cases treated' for all districts in Sierra Leone for the year 2023.
2. Configure the chart options to:
   - Sort the districts from High to Low (Descending).
   - Limit the view to show only the Top 10 districts.
   - Enable Value Labels to show the exact numbers on the bars.
   - Add the subtitle: 'Source: National Malaria Control Programme'.
3. Save the visualization as a favorite named 'Top 10 High Burden Malaria Districts 2023'.
4. Download/Export the chart as an image (PNG) and save it to '/home/ga/Desktop/malaria_top10.png'.
